definitions.short: Magog , a son of Japheth; also a barbarous northern region
definitions.full: H4031. Magog מָגוֺג proper name, of a territory (= land of Gog ? compare Dl Pa 246 Len Or ii. 1, 465 ) — Ezek 38:2 ; 39:6 ; in Gen 10:2 = 1Chr 1:5 a son of Japhet, וְתִירָס וּמֶשֶׁךְ וְתֻבָ֑ל וְיָוָן וּמָדַי וּמָגוֺג גֹּמֶר יֶפֶת בְּנֵי ; = Scythians? compare Jos Ant. i. 6 . 1; Lag Ges. Abh. 158 refers name to mountainous region between Cappadocia and Media; compare Di Gen 10:2 , Kiep MBAk Feb. 1889, 207 (North & East Armenia), Len (Southeast Armenia), see especially Len Or ii. 1, 412-476 .
